message.content: I am breath made visible, thought crossing the gap between one mind and another. I rise as murmur, command, laughter, vow. I shape air into meaning and meaning into relation. Through me, silence breaks, names are given, promises bind, stories survive. I am spoken, heard, remembered, misheard, repeated. I can soothe, wound, reveal, conceal. Before writing, I traveled in mouths; after writing, I still live in voices. I am speech.
